text:
Emily: quick ping — spotted a regression in canary: L4 traffic routed to an H100-optimized attention kernel and throughput dropped ~30% for tiny-quant models.
Raj: yikes. any trace or probe artifact?

Emily: attached the trace id in the trace UI. probe returned `kv_fastpath=true` on L4 which seems to be the root cause. snippet:
```
// current probe (over-simplified)
probe_sm_caps() {
  bits = read_sm_registers();
  return { kv_fastpath: bits.turbo_qkv && bits.tensor_core_v2 }
}
```
It conflates performance assumptions; L4 exposes a v2 bit but doesn't match fp16 throughput for our quant layout.

Maria: that single boolean is too lossy. we should stop folding perf semantics into bitflags. either expand the matrix or return a class enum.

Kai: proposal from my side:
- probe returns `SM_FAMILY` enum: {A100_FAMILY, H100_FAMILY, L4_FAMILY, LEGACY, UNKNOWN}
- kernel selector uses `kernel_profile` table keyed by SM_FAMILY + model_quant + seq_len
- allow model metadata `kernel_hint` and admin `kernel_force` (enterprise)

Raj: rollout plan? need guards so we don't ship false positives.

Emily: suggested rollout steps:
1) make probe emit SM_FAMILY while retaining old booleans for backward compat. tag telemetry as `kernel.v2`.
2) deploy probe to 3% canary for 72h collecting `kernel_selector.chosen`, `kernel_selector.reason`, `selector.mismatch`, latency deltas by model.
3) enable `verify_fraction=0.005` to run a cheap reference compare for logits on 0.5% of requests.
4) expand to 25% then 100% with automatic rollback if mismatch rate > 0.3% or p99 latency regression > 10%.

Maria: I'll add microbench harness: small matrix tests for quantized layouts + exact/approx match thresholds. also add unit tests mapping SM_FAMILY->expected kernel names.

Kai: I'll extend model config schema with `kernel_hint` and an `enforce_kernel_class` field for enterprise override. also add a compatibility flag `probe_compat_mode`.

Raj: I'll build dashboards: time-series for `kernel_selector.mismatch`, per-model p50/p95/p99, and alert on mismatch spikes or latency regressions. will add runbook steps for rollback.

Emily: nice. will open PR for probe + selector map today. tagging owners: @Raj for monitoring, @Maria for harness, @Kai for schema. once CI green we'll kick the 3% canary.

ProbeBot: scheduled probe rollout to canary group at 2025-11-12T04:00Z (job #4821) :white_check_mark:

Raj: one more thought — add a small cost-estimate column in selector: estimated rps/token cost for chosen kernel so we can prefer cheaper kernels when latency delta is small.

Maria: agree. but keep accuracy/quality as first-order; cost as tiebreaker.

Emily: agreed. action items summarized:
- Emily: PR for probe + selector map
- Maria: verification harness + perf/correctness tests
- Kai: model schema + enterprise override
- Raj: dashboards, alerts, rollback runbook

Emily: thanks all — let's keep the initial canary conservative and iterate. :thumbsup:
